page.layout: One column of running text, with a Greek line at the top of the column. No margin notes. Page number at the head. The word "qui" at the lower right is a catchword.

main_text.l: [illegible, ~8 letters] ὀνῶ[?], καὶ λόγῳ κεκοσμημένον. Patriarcha Ignatius fama evulgata Cæsarem Bardam nu-

l.i: rum fiam incestare, sæpius cum adhortatus est,
ut a simili piaculo abstineret, neque esset multis
offensio, qui virtutis ac pudicitiæ deberet

main_text.l: esse exemplum. Cæsar verbis veluti aculeis pun-
ctus odia in Patriarcham nutriebat. Cum vero
tandem ad communionem properantem Patriar-
cha repulisset, vix ille compos animi, & iracundia
ardens monitorem ad frugem, veluti iniquum, &
corruptorem ab Ecclesia eiicit, tormentisque
insanabilibus afflixit, cogens Patriarchatu re-
nunciare. Namque eum dedidit Theodoro co-
gnomento Moro, nec non Ioanni Gorgonitæ,
& Nicolao Scutelopi, qui in templo Apostolorum,
& Constantini Copronymi urna cruribus fractis
inclusum, hyemali tempestate nudum derelin-
quunt. Hinc Athleta ex occultis carnes putredi-
ne, & sanguine commixtas eiiciebat. Ita dira
perferens fortunatissimus hic vir, non est ad
Dominum malum locutus: ideoque mittit illi
Dominus Constantinum Armenium, qui esset
unicum illi in malis solatium. Hic etenim va-
sculo vitreo vini pleno, nec non & pane quandoq;
etiamfructibus[?], maleficorum conatus fallens, ad
Beatum accedens, eumque urna educens paulu-
lum adversos casus consolabatur, levabatque for-
tunas, donec denuo custodes accederent. Cæsar
interim Photium in Patriarchatum promouit,

page.notes: The first Greek line at the head is only partly legible; the opening word is illegible and "ὀνῶ" and "κεκοσμημένον" are uncertain. "quandoq;" and "etiamfructibus" are doubtful readings. "adversos" was read as "aduersos" in the scan and is written in modern u/v form. The printed word "nu-rum" is hyphenated at the line end. The bottom decoration is not printed text and is omitted.
